# Verifies @input(myEvent) with renamed event param: the lowered handler
# body references myEvent.value but JS emission canonicalizes to the
# event arg "e" and rewrites .value access as e.target.value.
#
# Legacy pipeline emits:
#   __n0.addEventListener("input", function(e) {
#     state.name = e.target.value;
#     __n0.value = state.name;
#     __n1.textContent = state.name;
#   });
# The user-chosen name "myEvent" disappears from the output entirely —
# JsIRContext.EventVar swap canonicalizes to "e". Plan D Task 10+ must
# preserve this canonicalization through the new htmlTranslator path.

sngl generate --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Handler emitted with canonical "e" param, not the user's "myEvent".
grep 'addEventListener\("input", function\(e\)' out/index.html
grep 'state.name = e.target.value' out/index.html

# User-chosen name should NOT appear in the script body.
! grep 'myEvent' out/index.html

# Inlined DOM patches for both bound nodes after the assignment.
grep '__n0.value = state.name' out/index.html
grep '__n1.textContent = state.name' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "Alice"
    input(value=name, @input(myEvent) { name = myEvent.value })
    text(value=name)
}
